neighbours.label: A word for a stake, eligibility or applicability inside a negated statement ('no vested interest', 'not applicable', 'not eligible', 'no stake'), firing on that word; the same statements without such a word stay quiet.
fire: The rule is not applicable to part-time staff.
I have no financial interest in the company.
Students over 25 are not eligible for the grant.
The judge had no personal stake in the case.
These limits are not applicable in winter.
He has no vested interest in the outcome.
Visitors are not eligible to vote.
We have no commercial interest in the product.
quiet: The rule was written for part-time staff.
I bought a few shares in the company.
Students over 25 can apply next year.
The judge was new to the case.
These limits are lower in winter.
He waited calmly for the outcome.
We tested the product last week.

notes: Card: ' interest' x4, ' eligible' x2, ' applicable', ' off', ' stake' (are not⟦ applicable⟧ to an older victim; no vested⟦ interest⟧); output promotes ' merely', ' available', ' allowed'. Exploratory probe: 'no vested interest' 0.49, 'not applicable' 0.26; 'protects older victims' 0.03.
